Connect Claude

  1. In the Block app, open Settings > AI > Connect an assistant. Tap Copy address.
  2. On claude.ai or in Claude Desktop, open Customize > Connectors. Choose + Add > Add custom connector, name it Block, and paste the address.
  3. Connect it and sign in on Block's page with your Block email. Use an email code or your password.
  4. Check the account and the access requested, then tap Allow. Start a chat and ask what you lifted in your last session.

If your organization manages connectors, an owner may need to add Block first. A custom connector uses the access and limits of your Claude plan. See Claude’s connector guide for the current setup options.

Block's address:

https://nxpgkslswhqsedttcrqv.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp

You do not need a Block API key or your own Claude key for this connection.

Signed up with Apple?

Open Settings > AI > Connect an assistant > Set a password in Block. Set a password of at least eight characters. On the connection page, choose Use a password instead.

Use the email shown in the app. If you chose Hide My Email, this can be an Apple relay address. Copy email copies the correct address.

Start with your own numbers

The assistant can read saved sessions, look up your records, write workouts, and create or change training blocks. Try one of these requests:

  • “Read my last 12 weeks and tell me which lifts have stalled.”
  • “Build an eight-week block with four training days. Show me the plan before saving it.”
  • “Log today's Lower A: squat 3 × 5 at 315 lb and RDL 3 × 8 at 225 lb.”

The assistant reads saved sessions. The AI trainer inside Block (Pro, iOS 27) can also work with an open session.

Access and privacy

An assistant saves changes when its tools run. There is no approval sheet in the Block app for those changes. Block asks the assistant to explain a change first. Check the tool permissions in your assistant.

The assistant can read your training data and profile. It can log sessions and measurements, change workouts and blocks, and delete workouts or sessions when asked.

It cannot see your password, create or read API keys, or delete your account. It sees only the data returned by Block's tools. That data then follows the assistant provider's privacy terms.

Assistant messages use your plan with that provider. They do not use the built-in trainer's monthly allowance. Without Block Pro, the assistant can read Block's help and research, but cannot use your training data.

See the privacy policy for details.

Disconnect an assistant

Open Settings > AI > Connected assistants in Block. Revoke the connection you want to remove. Its access ends at once. You can also remove Block from the assistant's connector settings.

To switch Block accounts, revoke the old connection and reconnect with the other account. Each assistant connection has its own entry.

Claude Code and other clients

Claude Code can use the same signed-in connection:

claude mcp add --transport http block https://nxpgkslswhqsedttcrqv.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp

In Claude Code, run /mcp, choose block, and sign in in the browser. Add --scope user after add to use the connection across projects.

For another assistant with custom MCP support, use the same server address and sign-in flow. Availability depends on the provider and your plan. Block's connections in Gemini and ChatGPT have not yet been verified.

For scripts, create a Block API key in Settings > Advanced > API keys. This is separate from an Anthropic API key and is part of Block Pro.

Tool reference
The 16 tools a connected assistant can use, and what each reads or changes
ToolKindWhat it reads or changes
get_profileReadsYour units, default rest, gym (plates and bars) and About you.
list_workoutsReadsYour sessions, newest first, set by set with each set's lamps. Up to 100 at a time, from any dates.
get_workoutReadsOne session with every set.
exercise_historyReadsOne lift's recent sessions with the heaviest set, estimated max and volume of each, and the lift's all-time records.
list_routinesReadsYour workouts with their sets, and your folders and training blocks with their weeks, training days or rolling cycle.
search_exercisesReadsThe built-in library and your custom exercises, by name, muscle or equipment.
list_body_measurementsReadsBody weight, body fat and circumferences, newest first.
app_helpReadsBlock's help, to answer questions about how to use the app.
researchReadsThe 37 research cards, each with its level of evidence, most with links to their studies.
log_workoutChangesLogs a session, or changes one. It saves each set it sends as a logged set.
save_routineChangesMakes a workout or changes one: its lifts, sets, reps or rep range, loads, rest, target RPE, prep lifts, notes and folder.
save_blockChangesMakes a training block or changes one: its name, start day, weeks, deload, training days or rolling cycle. It can also turn a block back into a folder.
create_exerciseChangesAdds a custom exercise.
log_body_measurementChangesAdds a body measurement.
delete_routineDeletesDeletes a workout. The sessions you logged from it stay.
delete_workoutDeletesDeletes a session and its sets.

Connection checks

No tools in the chat
Enable Block in the chat's connector settings. If the connector asks you to sign in again, reconnect it.
Block Pro is required
Check that you connected the correct Block account. Restore purchases in Settings > Block Pro if needed. The connection works again when that account has Pro.
Wrong email or password
Use the email shown in Connect an assistant. For an Apple account, set a password in Block first.
A saved change is missing from the app
Pull down on Today or Plan to reload your data.

For a missing email code or another problem, see Help & contact.
